description:

title: Enable OTEL trace collection for agent runs in MLflow
description:
Claude Code agent runs should emit OTEL traces to the MLflow harbor-rhoai experiment. Infrastructure partially set up: claude-otel-config ConfigMap created, env_from_configmaps support added to adapter. But traces aren't appearing — the RHOAI-bundled MLflow may not have OTLP receiver enabled, or may need a different endpoint/protocol. Needs investigation of MLflow version and OTLP support on RHOAI 3.4 EA2.

ConfigMap on cluster: claude-otel-config (evalhub namespace)
SA token for MLflow auth: mlflow-claude-tracing-token (evalhub namespace)
Internal MLflow: https://mlflow.redhat-ods-applications.svc.cluster.local:8443

comments.author: Ambient Code Bot
comments.text: Investigation findings: Claude Code uses MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI + MLFLOW_CLAUDE_TRACING_ENABLED (not OTEL_* vars) for traces. This session sends traces successfully to exp 11. But Claude Code in -p (print/one-shot) mode in K8s pods does NOT emit traces — likely the tracing subsystem doesn't initialize for short-lived invocations. ConfigMap is set up correctly (claude-otel-config), MLflow-direct route is reachable from pods, SA token auth works. Next step: investigate if there's a flag to force trace flush in -p mode, or if traces only work in interactive sessions.
